$comment: Machine-readable specification of the PEA 'Sugerir un recurso / Suggest a resource' form. Source of truth for building or rebuilding the Airtable form. Checked by maintenance/scripts/check-parity.js. No personal data belongs in this file (the repo is public).

meta.audience: PEA alumni (Danny Hernández, 2026-11-14: alumni only for now)
meta.airtable_form_status: draft, created 2026-11-14 from this spec; Danny reviews and publishes in the Airtable form builder
builder_only: hidden_defaults (Review Status = New, Role = PEA alum)

label_format: Spanish / English on one line; Spanish first

intro.es: Para egresados de la Academia de Padres Educadores: comparta un sitio web, video o documento gratuito que le haya ayudado. El equipo de PEA lo revisará antes de publicarlo.
intro.en: For Parent Educator Academy alumni: share a free website, video or document that helped you. The PEA team reviews it before it is published.

label.es: ¿Qué es y cómo ayuda a las familias?
label.en: What is it, and how does it help families?

help.es: Si no está seguro/a, elija la última opción.
help.en: If you're not sure, choose the last option.

choices.value: Liderazgo y defensa educativa / Advocacy & Leadership
Alfabetización digital y tecnología / Digital Literacy & Tech
Navegando sistemas escolares / Navigating School Systems
Para empezar en PEA / Getting Started with PEA
Oportunidades y aprendizaje continuo / Opportunities & Continued Learning

label.es: Correo electrónico que usó en PEA

help.es: Lo usamos para confirmar que es egresado/a de PEA y para contactarle sobre su sugerencia.
help.en: We use it to confirm you are a PEA alum and to contact you about your suggestion.

help.es: Solo para preguntas sobre su sugerencia.
help.en: Only for questions about your suggestion.

footer_note.es: No incluya información personal de su familia.
footer_note.en: Please don't include your family's personal information.

confirmation.es: ¡Gracias! Revisamos las sugerencias cada dos semanas.
confirmation.en: Thank you! We review suggestions every two weeks.

must_not_be_on_form.reason: Linked-record fields on a public form let anyone browse the linked table; All alumni's primary field is each alum's email.

after_submit.how: Airtable automation (trigger: record created in Submissions)
after_submit.action: Find the All alumni record whose Alumni ID equals the submitted email (trimmed, lowercase). If found, link it in Alumni ID and copy the email into ID. Email Confirmation then shows Match; otherwise Missing.
after_submit.if_no_match: Reviewer contacts the person or sets Review Status to Not Now (alumni only for now).

after_submit.action: Send an email to pea@allineducation.org with subject 'Nueva sugerencia de recurso / New resource suggestion' and the Link, Topic and Description.

review.approve_when: Email Confirmation = Match, all four Alignment checks and all six Quality checks ticked
review.on_approval: Create a Resources row (Status Published, Kind Outside resource, Title (ES/EN), links, Languages served when one link serves both pages, Topic, no class), link it in Resource, set Review Status Published. The next sync brings it to the site.

site_hookup.effect: Shows the 💡 Sugerir un recurso card and the no-results link on Materiales y recursos.
